gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.

gaps.explanation: 'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.
